goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Fresh targeted and full checks pass, but T025 is not ready for browser QA. Restore defaults changes persisted/form state without reconfiguring or cancelling the live activation controller. Context-menu suppression keeps stale tokens across later unaccepted primary presses and matches only the initial coordinate, so Control-drag completion can leak a menu while a rapid ControlRight or handle click can be wrongly suppressed. Zero-width or zero-height SVG objects receive non-rendering halo rectangles. The default inspector hint still teaches obsolete M-empty-canvas behavior. Canvas-target and hover-feedback boundaries also need tightening.

worker_package.objective: Close the remaining Control-selection integration gaps as one bounded remediation: route Restore defaults through live activation reconfiguration and cancellation; implement behaviorally tested causal context-menu suppression for accepted clicks and drags without stale-token leakage; restrict region capture to actual canvas targets; make halos visible for axis-aligned zero-extent objects; synchronize hover clearing when a region begins; and make inline guidance follow the configured activation.
verify: npm run test -- --run tests/client-ux.test.ts tests/editor-interactions.test.ts tests/editor-serialization.test.ts tests/selection-preferences.test.ts
stop_if: Any required implementation file is outside allowed_files.
Restore defaults cannot use the same activation-change cancellation path as an ordinary preference change.
Context-menu suppression cannot be represented as a behaviorally tested, one-shot causal interaction state.
Ordinary right-click, ControlRight, genuine handles, disconnected-banner controls, or events outside the canvas can be suppressed or captured.
Control-click or Control-drag can show a native context menu on macOS.
Minimum halo visibility requires changing authored geometry, filters, exported SVG, dirty state, or history.
The remediation changes preference storage, workspace/session schemas, or generalized transform behavior.
Space/middle pan, ordinary object drag, handles, exact selection, M behavior, or cancellation regresses.
Existing unrelated dirty hunks cannot be preserved.
The same verification failure remains unexplained after two attempts.
acceptance_checks: Resetting from M to defaults while merely armed or actively dragging cancels cleanly, configures Left Control immediately, removes ready/overlay state, and requires a fresh ControlLeft keydown.
An accepted Control click and a Control drag ending far from its origin suppress their causally associated contextmenu event.
Every later pointerdown invalidates an older context-menu token before optionally creating a new accepted token.
ControlRight, actual transform handles, ordinary right-click, connection-banner controls, and outside-stage events never consume or create suppression.
Horizontal and vertical line selections receive visibly nonzero individual halo geometry without changing clean SVG or history.
Beginning a region clears canvas hover and publishes hover-free selection context so Layers cannot retain stale salmon prediction.
The persistent inspector hint and shortcut help both describe the currently configured Left Control or M behavior.

evidence.proof: Ordinary preference changes detect regionActivation changes, cancel the gesture, and call marqueeActivation.configure. Restore defaults bypasses that path: it resets storage, updates the editor and form, but leaves the live activation controller unchanged. After restoring from M, the UI says Left Control while M still arms.

The token stores only pointerdown coordinates. A Control drag ending more than 8 pixels away will not suppress a contextmenu delivered at the terminal coordinate, despite being causally associated with the accepted gesture.

Only a non-primary pointerdown clears the prior token. A later unaccepted primary ControlRight press or ControlLeft press on a real handle can inherit the previous accepted token and have its context menu incorrectly suppressed when close in time and coordinates.

canStartRegionSelection accepts every Element except real handles. Because arbitration is stage-capture, interactive HTML overlays inside the stage, including the disconnected-preview banner and retry control, are treated as region candidates rather than non-canvas UI.

Halo rectangles copy rbox width and height exactly. An axis-aligned SVG line has a zero dimension; an SVG rect with zero width or height does not render, violating mandatory visible feedback for every selected object.

beginMarquee removes the hover marker through #clearHover but does not publish selection context. The canvas salmon marker disappears, while the Layers row can retain its stale predicted class until commit or cancellation.
Shortcut-dialog copy follows the preference, but the persistent inspector hint still always says to hold M and drag empty canvas, contradicting the default Left Control start-anywhere contract.

ControlLeft identity, ControlRight exclusion, capture-before-object precedence, actual-handle exclusion, frozen candidate and Shift, irreversible 4px latching, Control exact toggle, M no-op, Space/middle precedence, and successor-click suppression are implemented with substantive controller/editor coverage.

Keyup, Escape, blur, hidden visibility, editable/modal focus, pointercancel, lost capture, review cancellation, and marquee completion converge through gesture cancellation and editor restoration. Restore defaults is the remaining bypass.

The strict v2 record defaults to left-control, migrates exact v1 only when v2 is absent, rejects malformed/extra/future v2 atomically, preserves the four legacy values, and remains independent of workspace/session state.

Halos are editor-only, pointer-events-none, aria-hidden, filter-independent, stripped from clean and snapshot serialization, and excluded from hit testing and Layers. Every ordinary nonzero selected object gets an individual halo; only the primary gets blue svg.js handles, with no union box or shared transform.

The statusbar badge remains outside both sidebars, is hidden below two selections, exposes role=status with polite atomic announcements, and updates only when count text changes. Selection rendering expands every selected ancestry, clears a hiding filter, marks all rows aria-pressed, strengthens the primary, and scrolls only it.

evidence.command: npm run test -- --run tests/client-ux.test.ts tests/editor-interactions.test.ts tests/editor-serialization.test.ts tests/selection-preferences.test.ts
evidence.proof: Four files and 190 tests passed. The open findings are absent from the current regression matrix.
Typecheck, all 380 tests, and production build passed. Green verification does not cover the identified integration boundaries.

items: Choose M activation, hold M and begin a region gesture, then activate Restore defaults; verify cancellation, cleared overlay/cursor, Left Control UI, M no longer arming, and a fresh ControlLeft press being required.
On macOS, ControlLeft-click artwork and ControlLeft-drag more than 8 pixels from artwork and empty canvas; neither accepted gesture may open a context menu.

Immediately after an accepted Control gesture, ControlRight-click and ControlLeft-click a real resize or rotation handle at the same location; their context-menu behavior must remain native and the handles must remain interactive.
While disconnected-preview UI is visible, ControlLeft-click its retry button and banner; no region gesture may start and the control must remain operable.
Select horizontal and vertical SVG lines at 100% and non-default zoom with enhanced outlines both on and off; each must retain a crisp violet marker.
Hover artwork until canvas and Layers show salmon prediction, then start a Control or M region; both salmon indicators must disappear before commit.
Switch repeatedly between Left Control and M and confirm the persistent inspector hint, shortcut dialog, ready status, click behavior, and drag behavior always agree.

Repeat start-over-artwork and empty-canvas replace/add marquee, ordinary object drag, Space/middle pan, handle resize/rotation, cancellation paths, collapsed-sidebar badge, all-selected Layers rows, clean Save/Undo state, unchanged export, and empty console.
